newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Direct investment in Brazil rises in October-paper.
newsitem.headline: Direct investment in Brazil rises in October-paper.

text.p: Direct foreign investment in Brazil reached $935 million in October, nearly tripling from the previous month, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said on Tuesday.
Even with a record repatriation of $150 million last month, net direct foreign investment totalled $785 million, more than the double of that registered in September, the paper added.
Gazeta Mercantil said last month's direct investment surprised government officials, who were concerned about the effects of Brazil's trade deficit in the country's foreign accounts.
October's figures were only below of that registered in April and May, when direct investment amounted to $1.6 billion and $1.1 billion, respectively, the paper said.
Including October's data, net direct foreign investment has totalled a record $6.5 billion so far this year.
Despite last month's performance, Brazil may lose reserves due to high interest payments and October's trade deficit, it added.
